Case No.: GPA-2019-01 & Local Hazard Mitigation Plan Location: City-Wide
Applicant: City of Azusa
The City of Azusa has developed a Local Hazard Mitigation Plan (LHMP). Flood, drought, wildfire, earthquakes, and severe weather are just a few of the hazards to the City. While natural hazards such as these cannot be prevented, a Hazard Mitigation Plan forms the foundation for a community's long-term strategy to reduce disaster losses by breaking the repeated cycle of disaster damage and reconstruction. Additionally, only communities with a FEMA-approved Hazard Mitigation Plan are eligible to apply for both pre- and post-disaster mitigation grant funding. The General Plan Amendment will incorporate and reference the Local Hazard Mitigation Plan.
This action is not considered a project under the environmental review per Section 15-378 CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act) Guidelines.

CITY of AZUSA PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES

  October 9, 2019
  7:00 p.m.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports for the Planning Commission projects will
be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the
Planning Division and during regular hours at the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any
agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5289. The Planning Commission
Meeting will be held at 7:00 p.m. in the Civic Auditorium located at 213 E. Foothill Boulevard, Azusa,
California.

A)  CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Avila called the meeting to order at 7:00 pm.

B)  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Lee led the pledge of allegiance.

C)  ROLL CALL

  Members Present: AVILA, ALLEN, DONNELSON, and LEE
  Members Absent: RAMIREZ
  Staff Present: Todd Leishman, BB&K Attorney, Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager and
  Elijio Sandoval, Planning Technician

D)  MINUTES

1.  September 25, 2019

  Commissioner Donnelson made motion to approve the September 25, 2019 Planning

  NOES: NONE
  ABSTAIN: NONE

  previously approved project, The Avenue (DR-2018-15, UP-2018-04 (Alcohol), MUP-

  2. Case No.:  GPA-2019-01 & Local Hazard Mitigation Plan
  Location:  City-Wide
  Applicant:  City of Azusa

  The City of Azusa has developed a Local Hazard Mitigation Plan (LHMP). Flood,
  drought, wildfire, earthquakes, and severe weather are just a few of the hazards to the
  City. While natural hazards such as these cannot be prevented, a Hazard Mitigation Plan
  forms the foundation for a community's long-term strategy to reduce disaster losses by
  breaking the repeated cycle of disaster damage and reconstruction. Additionally, only
  communities with a FEMA-approved Hazard Mitigation Plan are eligible to apply for
  both pre- and post-disaster mitigation grant funding. The General Plan Amendment will
  incorporate and reference the Local Hazard Mitigation Plan.

  This action is not considered a project under the environmental review per Section 15-
  378 CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act) Guidelines.

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager, present the item.

  No comments or questions.

  approved with the following vote:

  ABSENT: NONE

  Manuel Muñoz, Planning Manager provides an update on Raising Cane’s, Consolidated

   PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  October 9, 2019

J)  DISCUSSION ITEMS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSIONERS

  Commissioners Ramirez, Lee and Donnelson thank Chair Avila for his service.

  Chair Avila thanks Commissioners, Staff and City and bids us farewell as Chair and
  Planning Commissioner. In addition, he asks staff about public noticing for future
  meetings discussing Consolidated Ready Mix.

  Todd Leishman, Legal Counsel from Best Best and Krieger (BB&K) Attorneys at Law,
  provided Commissioners and Staff with a legislative update and upcoming Municipal
  Code update as it relates to recently passed Housing Bills.
